verdict_msg: [CORRECTION_LIFTS_NO_REGRESSION] VerbNet affectedness lexicon correction (6 vetted verbs: burn,fix,open,shut,upset,write) | INDEPENDENT gold who-affected binary, ORIGINAL -> CORRECTED: UD-primary(N=52)=0.7692->0.8462(d=0.077) McGv1(N=34)=0.8824->0.8824 McGv2(N=38)=0.8158->0.8421 POOLED(N=124)=0.8145->0.8548(d=0.0403) | fixes=6 regressions=0 no_regression=True | scoreboard UD-primary budget closed=0.3333 (4/12 orig-wrong) | only_intended_verbs=True arms_differ=True ud_in_band=True | HONEST: correcting known-wrong entries improving them is partly EXPECTED; the tested claim is uniform-rule-fixes-a-class-without-regression + error-budget-closed.
note: Vetted ASSIGNMENT-correction of 6 systematically under-graded change-of-state/effected verbs (fix/burn/write seeds from scoreboard atom 29417; open/shut/upset from bounded gold-occurring candidate-pool audit) in the VerbNet affectedness lexicon; measured on 3 INDEPENDENT golds. WordNet DOMINANT-sense used as an independent cross-check (NOT the VerbNet grade we grade by). leave DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED (dominant sense = departure/motion; would regress 5 none). Corrected copy is SEPARATE; production lexicon unmutated. LOCAL-only; no push/remote-persist; no atom bank (skunkworks VETs after land).

correction_set.wordnet_vet: repair.v.01 [COS, TOP synset]: restore by replacing a part / putting together
write.v.01 [CREATE, TOP synset]: produce a literary work
open.v.01 'cause to open / become open' (TOP); open.v.03 [COS] 'become open'
upset.v.01 [COS, TOP synset]: disturb the balance or stability of

excluded_verbs.leave: TOP synset leave.v.01 = 'go away from a place' (MOTION/departure); gold {none:5,patient:1} -> blindly raising it FIXES 1 but BREAKS 5. WordNet dominant sense supports EXCLUSION.

scoreboard_error_budget.note: fraction of the ORIGINAL UD-primary base_gate errors closed by the lexicon correction; residual errors are parse/POS misses (pred_none) or over-fires on target_not_affected verbs -- NOT lexicon under-grading, so out of scope here.

design_gate.real_baseline: ORIGINAL lexicon gate; UD-primary reproduces scoreboard sb.score_row base_gate 0.7692 as a positive control (Gate-D reproducer)
design_gate.one_variable: the lexicon (ORIGINAL vs CORRECTED); front-end/reader/gold all fixed
design_gate.can_fail: corrected<=original+1e-9 (no lift) OR net regression (regressions>=fixes) OR corrected differs on any UNINTENDED verb/field
design_gate.difficulty_on: INDEPENDENT UD semantic gold (0.769, not saturated) + McGuffey v1 + v2
design_gate.hard_pass_band: UD-primary corrected >= 0.83 AND pooled lift>0 AND zero net regressions AND only-intended-verbs-changed
design_gate.honest_frame: correcting KNOWN-wrong entries and improving THOSE cases is partly EXPECTED; measured value = uniform vetted rule fixes a CLASS without regression + how much scoreboard error budget it closes. Corrections generalize only BY LOOKUP, never by learning (meaning=assignment).
design_gate.crlb_n/a: accuracy on labeled gold; no capacity/argmax noise floor

credit: VerbNet (Kipper-Schuler 2005); Levin 1993; Dowty 1991 proto-patient; Beavers 2011; WordNet (Fellbaum 1998) as independent dominant-sense cross-check; scoreboard atom 29417; v1/v2 hand-lexicon + held-out gate cells.
